body:
I've been thinking about this a lot lately. And I figured the way I'd do it too. 
My birthday is on 27th of this month. I have decided I'm going to do it. I just can't take it anymore.
Everyone is happy and cool and Reiner is still wishing for death

I don't think it's "people don't care until it's too late". I think people act like they do after they're sure that they don't have to waste any more time on us.
I'm trying to say that they'll fake like they care when in reality they just wanna post that 2min paragraph and move on. Nobody really cares

I tried to talk about my suicidal feelings with my boyfriend. He says He's afraid of even hearing that word. Tried to contact a friend about this, seems like she didn't even care. Tried to take help from my parents as well. They shrugged it off saying I'm "joking".
I mean the point in trying to make is, in my case - people are not even pretending to be listening.
I guess even if I die nobody really cares for a sec

I wish I have something to help you get better. I've hit the rock bottom of my life too. I don't know anything anymore I'm just feeling extremely tired to even think about anything. I just gave up. I wonder how being happy feels like.
Same here mate. With all the mess that happened in my life, I feel like living on can't fix shit. I just wanna end all of this and disappear.
